+# v2.0.8 Reliability Implementation Plan
+
+**Goal:** Fix confirmed stable gate failures and add explicitly approved OpenMDW-1.1 admission, without changing check names or advisory/blocking policy.
+
+**Architecture:** Keep the existing incremental pipeline. Bound and deduplicate static analysis, classify Git links separately from blobs, force trustworthy text diffs and mandatory Ruff configuration, and make operational failures explicit. No target code execution and no automatic license expansion beyond OpenMDW-1.1.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.9+, Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, unittest, pinned scanner images.
+
+## Approved design / alternatives
+
+Chosen: targeted v2.0.8 reliability release. Rejected: scanner bypasses (false passes) and broad license auto-approval (not authorized). User approved the scope and OpenMDW-1.1 admission on 2026-10-19. Original notices and license preservation still apply.
+
+## Tasks
+
+1. Add `tests/test_reliability.py`: bounded branch analysis, budget failures, gitlinks, attribute-hidden changes, isolated Ruff, safe scanner diagnostics and OpenMDW admission. Run `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_reliability.py -v`; confirm baseline failures using bounded inputs only.
+2. Fix `src/hygon_pr_gate/sensitive_diff_check.py`: deduplicate typed values and merge origins, enforce candidate/string/operation/time budgets before expansion. Test branch joins, loops, f-strings, format combinations and fail-closed budget outcomes.
+3. Fix `git_scope.py`, `native_checks.py`, `local_executor.py`: identify gitlinks from tree mode, skip blob scanning but retain path checks; disable textconv/external diff and force text patches; mandatory Ruff isolation/no-noqa. Prove F823 cannot be hidden by configs, attributes or inline suppressions.
+4. Improve executor diagnostics: classify missing images, ENOSPC, permissions, timeouts and missing/malformed reports; never expose untrusted scanner source/secret output. Add phase/version logs and Linux process limits. Do not change system Python or install node packages.

+# v2.0.8 — PR gate reliability
+
+## Fixes
+
+- Deduplicate Python branch/loop candidate values while retaining all source origins. Bound expression growth, work and time; report budget exhaustion as Invalid Scan, not a clean scan. Fixes Megatron-LM-das #117 runaway memory.
+- Recognize Git mode 160000 as a submodule commit reference, not a blob. Preserve path checks and `.gitmodules` scanning. Fixes pytorch-das #20.
+- Ignore textconv and external diff drivers and force textual Git hunks, so `.gitattributes -diff` cannot hide newly introduced findings.
+- Run mandatory Ruff checks in isolated/no-noqa mode. Caller per-file ignores and inline suppressions cannot disable E9/F63/F7/F82.
+- Preserve scanner exit codes and safe operational classifications for absent/malformed reports, missing images, ENOSPC, permissions and timeouts. Arbitrary raw scanner output is withheld. Clean up only the invocation's container on tool timeout.
+- Add phase timing, Python version reporting and native process resource limits. Prefer existing Python 3.12; never replace system Python or download an interpreter during PR scans.
+- Add explicitly approved `OpenMDW-1.1` to SPDX admission. Original notices still cannot be removed/replaced; this is not a claim of legal equivalence to MIT. Other license expressions retain existing review policy.
+
+## Unchanged
+
+Four job names and `Checks / All required checks`; secret and sensitive-word advisories; C/C++ exclusion from Semgrep; no Lizard/style checks; immutable scanner image references; offline PR scans; centralized policy trust.
+
+## Validation and rollout
+
+Candidate must pass unit/native/bootstrap and real-image regressions, including config/diff bypass pairs and expected failures. Replay actual Megatron and PyTorch base/head commits under a 1 GiB/60 CPU-second limit. Check nmz1/4/6. Hosted CI tests Python 3.9/3.11/3.12.
+
+Release only after required independent PR approval and passing CI. Create immutable v2.0.8 first, then move stable; verify both resolved commits. Do not alter existing immutable tags or bypass runner workflow restrictions. Callers pinned to v2.0.7 remain unchanged. Adding direct v2.0.8 callers requires the corresponding runner-group workflow allowlist entry; existing @stable callers do not need a new entry.
+
+Rollback anchor: previous stable tag object `11e41137c3691ea13be41aff761851f6e354ada9`, commit `ab2c31c23bbd538947ae2dbd60672c8c196ddaf2` (v2.0.7). A rollback also restores that version's known defects; use only after assessing the incident.
